channel.title: Roman Bediner Blog
channel.description: Field notes on AI, operations, and building better businesses.

item.title: The Wrong AI Agent Can Give You the Right Answer
item.description: How I choose between Claude Duet, ChatGPT Dot, Meta Muse and Grok Bot, and why I check the account and its access before I hand over client work.

item.title: My AI Agents Found My Rest Timer
item.description: Managing multiple AI agents? See when to send a ping, when to queue a decision, and how to measure the human time it takes to finish an AI-assisted job.

item.title: Your company has AI tools. Who owns making them useful?
item.description: AI tools do not settle cross-functional decisions. Give one workflow a responsible owner, clear authority and a practical test before expanding it.

item.title: How to Build an AI Creative Agency That Works for You
item.description: How Maya was designed to handle Sunset Grove’s Airbnb and Vrbo marketing, with 16 defined AI roles, shared business knowledge and accountable handoffs.

item.title: What did your AI spend actually buy?
item.description: Compare the next AI dollar with completed work, usable capacity and total workflow cost. A practical budget test for CEOs and business owners.

item.title: Make judgment reusable: help your business learn from AI work
item.description: Turn recurring AI corrections into clear standards, examples and decisions. A practical approach for CEOs who want the business to learn from reviewed work.

item.title: Your next AI agent needs an attention budget
item.description: Measure review time, corrections, and interruptions before expanding an AI agent. A practical pilot for business owners who want dependable capacity.

item.title: Agentic Society: Why business owners should build together
item.description: An inside perspective on Agentic Society: CEOs, business owners, and builders learning together, creating AI teams, and putting ideas to work online and in Austin.
